topics.topic: Function components and JSX syntax rules
topics.failure_scenario: The component fails to compile because multiple root elements are returned without being wrapped in a Fragment or container element.
topics.best_practice: Use React Fragments (<>...</>) to group adjacent elements without introducing extra markup to the DOM.

topics.failure_scenario: The application displays a blank page with a build syntax error because adjacent JSX elements were returned without a Fragment wrapper.
topics.best_practice: Always return a single root element or Fragment from every component render function.

seeded_failure.symptom: The development server displays a syntax error build failure and the product page fails to render.
seeded_failure.cause: The ProductCard component returns adjacent HTML elements directly without wrapping them in a Fragment or div element.
seeded_failure.fix: Wrap the adjacent elements inside React Fragments (<>...</>) and save the component file.

seeded_failure.symptom: The Vite dev server launches without terminal errors, but the browser displays a blank white screen with a console import resolution error.
seeded_failure.cause: A utility file uses a default export, but the importing file attempts to import it using curly braces as a named import.
seeded_failure.fix: Update the import statement to default import syntax or change the utility file export to a named export.
